name: TWO SIDES: Co-op Mystery
subtitle: Two players. One shared phone
promotionalText: Five complete mysteries, free to play together. Pass one phone, compare private clues and uncover the secrets of the Bellweather Hotel. Start with The Last Reservation.
description:
Two players. One phone. A hotel full of secrets.

Turn your next evening together into a detective story. TWO SIDES is a cooperative mystery game for two people sharing one phone. Each of you holds a different piece of the investigation. Read your private evidence, pass the phone, then talk through what you know. The truth only emerges when you put both sides together.

WELCOME TO THE BELLWEATHER HOTEL

Step into an atmospheric hotel in 1994, where witness accounts and hotel records do not always tell the same story. Compare clues, question your theories and make each deduction together.

FIVE COMPLETE MYSTERIES, FREE

Start with The Last Reservation, then investigate The Silent Piano, The Masquerade Coat, The Music Box and The Missing Envelope. Each case tells its own contained story, with private evidence, optional hints and a conclusion to uncover.

BUILT FOR TWO

- Play side by side with a friend or partner on one phone.
- Read separate evidence sheets through clear, private handoffs.
- Compare observations and choose your answers together.
- Keep confirmed deductions in your shared Notebook.
- Use three optional hints for every deduction, included.
- Save progress locally and return to each case later.
- Take your time: no timer, and no sound required.
- Set the mood with an original piano soundtrack and adjustable sound, haptics and larger body text.
- No game account or second device needed.

AFTER MIDNIGHT COLLECTION - OPTIONAL IN-APP PURCHASE

Three new mysteries unfold after dark: The Room That Was Never Booked, The Last Call at Midnight and The Portrait Behind the Wall.

One purchase. Two players. Three new mysteries.

One-time purchase. Hints included. No subscription. Includes the three After Midnight cases. Future collections sold separately. The five free mysteries remain free to play.

Pass the phone. Compare your clues. Uncover the truth together.
iapDescription: Unlock three Bellweather mysteries. Hints included.
reviewNotes:
TWO SIDES is a cooperative mystery game for two people sharing one iPhone. No game account or reviewer login is required. Five cases are permanently free. The optional After Midnight Collection is one non-consumable purchase unlocking exactly three additional cases; no subscription is offered.

Free content: launch to the case library, select The Last Reservation, start the case and use each role's readiness button to read the two private sheets. Pass the phone between roles and discuss clues before answering. Incorrect answers allow retry without a penalty. The Notebook records confirmed deductions only. Evidence revisits and resumes use a neutral handoff.

Paid content: open After Midnight Collection from the library, then use Unlock all 3 with the localized store price. Restore Purchases is on that collection screen. The purchase is processed through StoreKit and RevenueCat. The three paid cases are The Room That Was Never Booked, The Last Call at Midnight and The Portrait Behind the Wall. Free cases do not require ownership. Resetting a case does not reset ownership.

Help & Privacy and Settings are reachable from the library. Case progress is stored on the device. Sound is optional. There is no user-generated content, chat or game-account registration.
